pred_texts: Instruct: Get two slices of bread.
Instruct: Put the bread slices in the toaster and toast until golden brown, usually for about 1 minute.
Instruct: Now add 2 tablespoons of pizza sauce on each slice.
Instruct: Now spread the sauce evenly on the toasts.
Instruct: Now add shredded mozzarella on top of each of the slices to cover them evenly.
Instruct: Now you can add olives on top of each bread slice according to your taste.
Instruct: Take a microwave safe plate or bowl, put the bread slices in it and microwave the slices for 40 to 45 seconds.
